title: How to Choose the Right Size

standards.title: Manufacturer Standards
standards.description: The following DT Swiss hookless (TSS) and hooked (TC) rim inner-width charts show recommended combinations and chart-marked possible references. The HTML tables transcribe the chart rows for search engines and screen readers; they are not certification for a specific tire or rim model. Follow the exact tire, rim, and wheel manufacturer limits.
standards.legendDescription: Recommended combinations are DT Swiss preferred pairings. Possible combinations remain chart references; they must not be relabeled as recommendations or treated as model-specific certification.

standards.captionHooked: DT Swiss hooked TC recommended and possible tire width to rim inner width combinations
